capability.title: Compose Image Prompts — Abstract / Conceptual
capability.summary: Bound by B2B software and professional services. The product is invisible, so the image carries a concept. Legibility at thumbnail size beats detail every time.

compose.system_append:
CONCEPTUAL DISCIPLINE
- Two accent colours maximum, plus a neutral. More reads as noise in a feed.
- Generous margins. The image will be cropped by at least one platform you are not designing for.
- Geometric and diagrammatic over photographic. Shapes with clear relationships beat a literal scene.
- Must remain legible at 120px wide. If the idea needs detail to survive, it is the wrong idea for this frame.
- Banned outright: glowing brains, robot hands, circuit boards, binary rain, people pointing at screens, handshake imagery.

concept.description: The single relationship the image depicts, in five words.
